results.title: Vietnam-China trade set to surpass US$350 billion in 2026
results.snippet:
Preliminary data from Vietnam Customs show Vietnam’s exports to China totaled US$77.52 billion, up 36.2% year on year, while its imports surged 40.5% to US$212.46 billion, resulting a trade deficit of US$134.94 billion, up 43.2% from a year earlier. The 10-month trade deficit has already far exceeded the US$116 billion recorded for the whole of last year.
